historicalReleaseEvidenceRule: Current-root cleanup never rewrites or deletes shipped Git history, Stable tags, published releases, or immutable release evidence.
newRootFileRule: A new root file must be canonical or explicitly registered as transitional with owner, reason, expiry and removal condition.

extreme_30_test_fixture_test.go.reason: The permanent Extreme-30 matrix depended on two generic fixture helpers from the retired pre-v17 test stack. The helpers are retained here without restoring any v14/v15/v16 test file.
extreme_30_test_fixture_test.go.removalCondition: Inline or consolidate the fixture under the final capability-oriented test owner and remove the temporary v15TestApp call-site alias while preserving all Extreme-30 assertions.

global_market_providers.go.reason: Live production logic formerly carried by v14_0_3.go is preserved under a capability-oriented current owner before later package decomposition.
global_market_providers.go.removalCondition: Move the implementation and its current tests together into the canonical provider capability package with full equivalence evidence.

live_subscription_manager.go.reason: Live multi-feed subscription and failover logic formerly carried by v14_3_3.go is preserved under a capability-oriented current owner before later package decomposition.
live_subscription_manager.go.removalCondition: Move the implementation and its current tests together into the canonical live-subscription capability package with full equivalence evidence.

performance_regression_test.go.reason: The retired pre-v17 v16.8 and v16.10 performance gates carried material 500-symbol/candidate runtime and allocation ceilings plus v16.11 long-run capacity assertions. They are preserved under a version-neutral package-test owner so Fast and Qualified full Go suites continue to enforce them without restoring legacy version-named files.
performance_regression_test.go.removalCondition: Move the bounded performance assertions with their implementation capability during package decomposition; do not remove the ceilings unless equivalent current performance evidence remains executable.

retired_equivalence_regression_test.go.reason: Version-neutral package tests preserve specialized event/macro/news assertions from policy-retired pre-v17 families when generic full-suite execution alone cannot prove semantic equivalence. This owner is assertion-level evidence, not a compatibility wrapper or restored legacy version file.
retired_equivalence_regression_test.go.removalCondition: Move each preserved assertion with its final capability package/test owner during decomposition and update the retired-test evidence bindings atomically; no assertion may disappear merely because its original version-named source was retired.

signal_intelligence_regression_test.go.reason: Version-neutral package tests preserve the retired signal outcome-ordering, frozen evidence identity, split-adjusted outcome, seasonality, calibration and correlation/concentration assertions that generic full-suite execution did not independently prove.
signal_intelligence_regression_test.go.removalCondition: Move these assertions with the final signal-validation/market-intelligence capability package and update retired-test bindings atomically; preserve all outcome, seasonality, calibration and concentration semantics.

safeRemovalRule: Pre-v17 version-scoped current-root artifacts are explicitly retired by ADAPT-CI-CONVERGENCE-001; all other deletion still requires assertion/evidence mapping.
